description: The puzzle module (packages/core/docs/genre-mechanics.md §3): riddles answered by the world’s own facts and locks opened by what was found. Each kb opens with packages/core/src/puzzle/puzzle-predicates.ts verbatim; regenerate with npm run genre-mechanics-corpus. A riddle names a relation and a subject and is never given its answer: puzzle_relation_answer/3 asks business_owner/2, lives_at/2, married_to/2, parent_of/2, occupation/2, truth_about/2, text_author/2 or business_type/2. A need is compared as its two atoms (puzzle_unmet_need/4), never as a term. World cases run over conformance/genre-mechanics/thistlecombe.world-slice.json, a slice of a real Insimul world (the Unity closing-wave export of Thistlecombe) cut by npm run genre-world-slice; their facts are what core’s generators produce from it and their expectations are what core’s TypeScript resolution says.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-riddle-and-does-not-raise
kb: puzzle_answer(R, X) :- puzzle_riddle(R, Rel, S), puzzle_relation_answer(Rel, S, X).
puzzle_correct(R, Given) :- nonvar(Given), puzzle_riddle(R, _, _), \+ \+ puzzle_answer(R, Given).
puzzle_spent(A, R) :- puzzle_max_attempts(M), puzzle_attempts(A, R, N), N >= M.
puzzle_riddle_open(A, R) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_riddle(R, _, _), \+ puzzle_solved(A, R), \+ puzzle_spent(A, R), \+ (puzzle_riddle_clue(R, T), \+ puzzle_clue_found(A, T)).
puzzle_need_met(A, item(I)) :- has_item(A, I, N), N > 0.
puzzle_unmet(A, L, Need) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock_needs(L, Need), \+ puzzle_need_met(A, Need).
puzzle_unmet_need(A, L, Kind, Ref) :- puzzle_unmet(A, L, Need), Need =.. [Kind, Ref].
puzzle_can_unlock(A, L) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock(L, _), \+ puzzle_opened(A, L), \+ puzzle_unmet(A, L, _).
puzzle_can_take(A, I) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock_holds(L, I), puzzle_opened(A, L), \+ has_item(A, I, _).

puzzle_correct(R, Given) :- nonvar(Given), puzzle_riddle(R, _, _), \+ \+ puzzle_answer(R, Given).
puzzle_spent(A, R) :- puzzle_max_attempts(M), puzzle_attempts(A, R, N), N >= M.
puzzle_riddle_open(A, R) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_riddle(R, _, _), \+ puzzle_solved(A, R), \+ puzzle_spent(A, R), \+ (puzzle_riddle_clue(R, T), \+ puzzle_clue_found(A, T)).
puzzle_need_met(A, item(I)) :- has_item(A, I, N), N > 0.
puzzle_unmet(A, L, Need) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock_needs(L, Need), \+ puzzle_need_met(A, Need).
puzzle_unmet_need(A, L, Kind, Ref) :- puzzle_unmet(A, L, Need), Need =.. [Kind, Ref].
puzzle_can_unlock(A, L) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock(L, _), \+ puzzle_opened(A, L), \+ puzzle_unmet(A, L, _).
puzzle_can_take(A, I) :- nonvar(A), puzzle_lock_holds(L, I), puzzle_opened(A, L), \+ has_item(A, I, _).
